result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from all seven listing and lookup methods. The promotion tests pass offline, including a new test for the round trip.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: added `description VARCHAR(200)` to `promotion`. It is nullable, so older promotions simply have none.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: the record gets a `description` component at the end. Its Javadoc now says the description is null when there is none.
- **`DataStore.java`**: `createPromotion` writes the description. `findPromotionByCode`, `listPromotionsActiveOn`, `listPromotionsActiveOnInRegion`, `listPromotionsByCategory`, `findBestPromotion` and `listUnusedPromotions` select and map it. The edits are limited to those methods.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new six-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. The existing five-argument version delegates with no description, so the existing callers and `DemoScenario` are unchanged. A null or blank description is stored as null, the same way blank categories are handled.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionOfPromotion` test. It checks that the SUMMER description comes back from active, category and unused listings, and that a promotion created without one has none.

I did not run the full test suite. I did not commit.
